input: How much does the Pro plan cost?
expected_output: The Pro plan costs 8 dollars per user per month.

input: How much storage do I get on the Free plan?
expected_output: The Free plan includes 5 GB of storage.

input: Can I get a refund on my annual subscription?
expected_output: Yes, annual subscriptions are refunded in full within 14 days of purchase.

input: What is the largest file I can upload on a paid plan?
expected_output: A single file can be up to 50 GB on paid plans.
Sharing links expire after 30 days by default.

input: I deleted a file by mistake, how long can I restore it from the trash?
expected_output: Deleted files stay in the trash for 30 days and can be restored from the web app.

input: For how long is version history kept on Business accounts?
expected_output: Business accounts keep version history for 1 year.

input: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
expected_output: Open Settings, then Security, and scan the QR code with an authenticator app.

input: How long is the password reset link valid?
expected_output: The password reset link is valid for 1 hour.

input: Which plan do I need for single sign-on with Okta?
expected_output: Single sign-on is available only on the Business plan.

input: How many API requests per minute can I make?
expected_output: The API allows 1000 requests per minute for each access token.

input: What HTTP status do I get when I exceed the API rate limit?
expected_output: Requests over the rate limit receive HTTP status 429.

input: Can I move my workspace data from the US region to the EU region?
expected_output: No, the region is chosen when the workspace is created and cannot be changed later.

input: Will my free account be deleted if I do not use it?
expected_output: Yes, Free accounts inactive for 12 months are deleted after an email warning.

input: Can a monthly plan be refunded?
expected_output: No, monthly subscriptions are not refunded, but they can be cancelled at any time.

input: Can I work on my folders without internet?
expected_output: Yes, the desktop app can make folders available offline and syncs changes when you reconnect.

input: If I delete a file, can I still get an older version of it?
expected_output: Deleted files can be restored from the trash for 30 days; previous versions are kept for 90 days on Pro and 1 year on Business.

input: How much storage does the Pro plan include and what is the largest file I can upload?
expected_output: The Pro plan includes 2 TB of storage and a single file can be up to 50 GB.
